title: Motor imagery dataset for three imaginary states of the same upper extremity
description: This dataset comprises electroencephalographic recordings from 12 healthy subjects performing three-class motor imagery tasks involving the right upper extremity: rest, right hand grasping, and right elbow flexion. Data were collected across 4 sessions per subject using a 32-channel EGI system at 1000 Hz sampling rate, with visual cues guiding 3-second imagery trials. The dataset includes 2,880 trials total and was designed to evaluate time-domain feature extraction and support vector machine classification for brain-computer interface applications. This is a BIDS-formatted derivative of the original 2017 Tavakolan et al. dataset, converted and standardized using the Mother of All BCI Benchmarks (MOABB) framework.
methods_description: EEG data were acquired using a 32-channel EGI Geodesic Net Amps 400 series system (GSN-HydroCel-32 montage) at 1000 Hz sampling rate with Cz reference. Online bandpass filtering (0.1-100 Hz) was applied. Subjects performed three-class motor imagery tasks (rest, right hand grasping, right elbow flexion) guided by visual cues, with 20 trials per class per session across 4 sessions. Trial duration was 3 seconds. Impedance threshold was maintained at 50 kOhm.
